narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services recorded $85.6M in obligations in FY2027 to date. OptumServe Health Services received 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $42.8M. Obligations fell 95.5% year over year. OptumServe Health Services obligated $874M in FY22, $711M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, $2.5B in FY25, and $1.9B in FY26, showing larger prior-year activity compared with FY2027 to date. The Department of Veterans Affairs accounted for $83.4M of FY2027 to date obligations, and the Department of Health and Human Services accounted for $2.2M. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) accounted for $83.4M of obligations by market, and All Other Outpatient Care Centers accounted for $2.2M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals.

sections.heading: Who are the main federal buyers of OptumServe Health Services?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the primary buyer, obligating $83.4M in FY2027 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services is the secondary buyer, obligating $2.2M. These two agencies together account for the full set of listed FY2027 to date buying agencies.

sections.heading: What products and NAICS markets does OptumServe Health Services serve?
